title: Americana
tagline: American roots traditions retold with a modern, independent voice.
summary: Americana brings together strands of American roots music, including folk, country, blues, and gospel. Rather than a single sound, it describes a broad tradition of songcraft and instrumentation shaped by regional histories. Contemporary artists reinterpret these sources through personal writing, independent production, and an ongoing conversation between old forms and new audiences.

pillars.name: Emmylou Harris
pillars.why: Emmylou Harris has moved across country, folk, and roots traditions while keeping song interpretation at the center.

pillars.name: Lucinda Williams
pillars.why: Lucinda Williams combines literary songwriting with blues and country influences in a distinctive roots-rock voice.

pillars.name: The Band
pillars.why: The Band drew on multiple American roots styles and helped establish a durable ensemble approach to Americana.
